init.description:
Configure AI conversation agents, prompts, and settings.

*Note: Custom prompts provided as-is without warranty - placeholder {question} must remain present.*

data.announce_model: Announce model name at the end of the answer
data.short_answers: Enforce short answers for speech (1-2 sentences)
data.enable_detailed_followup: Offer follow-up for a more detailed explanation
data.followup_prompt: Follow-up question prompt text (e.g. 'Yes or No?')
data.retry_prompt: Reprompt message when query is unclear/nonsense
data.abort_prompt: Final exit message after second failed attempt
data.prompt_short: AI prompt for short answer (as-is, must include {question})
data.prompt_detailed: AI prompt for detailed explanation (as-is, use placeholders {question} and {previous_answer})
